data.title: 中野四叶 · 毛毯裹紧的雨夜依偎
data.description: 雷声隆隆的漆黑雨夜里，四叶身着宽松的纯棉居家服，把自己紧紧裹在一床柔软厚实的绒毯中。她赤足缩在榻榻米一角，像只受惊的小动物般小心翼翼地凑到少年身旁，双颊绯红地轻扯着对方的衣襟，寻求着最安心的温暖。
data.action: wrapped in blanket, curled up, blushing, holding onto sleeve
data.lighting: warm bedside nightlamp and lightning flash
data.promptProse: Curled up snugly in a thick fleece blanket on a tatami floor during a stormy night, Nakano Yotsuba wears her light green loungewear. She blushes deeply as she clings gently to the viewer's sleeve, seeking comforting warmth from the thunderstorm.
data.animaCaption: Yotsuba curled in a blanket seeking comfort on a stormy night.
